python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data from the tables - Borrowing from the public federal securities (Total 10+11-12)
# Values in millions of dollars
data = {
    2016: 1051824,
    2017: 498301,
    2018: 1084458,
    2019: 1051606,
    2020: 4216280,
    2021: 1267947,
    2022: 1969817,
    2023: 1982672,
    2024: 1959809
}

# Calculate natural log of each value
ln_values = {year: math.log(value) for year, value in data.items()}

print("Year | Borrowing (millions) | ln(value)")
print("-" * 50)
for year in sorted(data.keys()):
    print(f"{year} | {data[year]:>13,} | {ln_values[year]:.6f}")

# Get sorted ln values
sorted_ln = sorted(ln_values.values())
print("\nSorted ln values:")
print(sorted_ln)

# 20% trimmed mean: trim 20% from each end
# 20% of 9 values = 1.8, so we trim 1 value from each end
n = len(sorted_ln)
trim_count = int(n * 0.20)
print(f"\nTrim count from each end: {trim_count}")

# Trimmed values
trimmed = sorted_ln[trim_count:n-trim_count]
print(f"Trimmed values ({len(trimmed)} values):")
print(trimmed)

# Calculate trimmed mean
trimmed_mean = sum(trimmed) / len(trimmed)
print(f"\n20% Trimmed Mean of ln(values): {trimmed_mean:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest thousandth: {round(trimmed_mean, 3)}")

# Write answer
with open('/app/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(round(trimmed_mean, 3)))
print(f"\nAnswer written to /app/answer.txt")
EOF
